in_marathi.name: Dhirendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Thoughts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhirendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhirendra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dhi' meaning 'thought' and 'indra' meaning 'ruler'. This name signifies one who rules over thoughts and has the power to control and direct them.
